body:
Source: 2026-09-20 repository review, orchestration area: fault-injection switches reachable in production code. Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea: `packages/autopilot/lib/mutations.mjs:16-21` keeps the seam registry on the WRITABLE global `globalThis.__adlcAutopilotMutations` and `enable()` (line 64) is an unconditional export; 58 of 63 lib files consult it (293 `active('…')`/`seam('…')` sites, 259 names), among them `keys.mjs:62` (`keys.leakKey`: manifest key added to every child env), `dispatch.mjs:37` (`dispatch.keyInFleetEnv`: key in the fleet worker env), `token-refresh.mjs:63` (`tokenRefresh.keepKey`), `fleet-args.mjs:35` (`fleetArgs.leakEnvToHelper`), `spawn.mjs:78` (`spawn.shellTrue`), `redact.mjs:87` (`redactor.disable`). Repro 1 (exit 0, prints `true {"PATH":"/usr/bin","ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY":"kkkk..."}`): `node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('./packages/autopilot/lib/mutations.mjs'); globalThis.__adlcAutopilotMutations.active.add('keys.leakKey'); const k = await import('./packages/autopilot/lib/keys.mjs'); console.log(m.active('keys.leakKey'), JSON.stringify(k.childEnv({ PATH: '/usr/bin' }, { key: 'k'.repeat(32) })))"`. Repro 2 (exit 1, `TypeError: s.known.add is not a function`, because `globalThis[KEY]` walks the prototype chain): `node --input-type=module -e "Object.defineProperty(Object.prototype, '__adlcAutopilotMutations', { value: { active: [], known: [] }, configurable: true }); await import('./packages/autopilot/lib/mutations.mjs')"`.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/autopilot`: `bin/adlc-autopilot.mjs` (the only production entry; `adlc autopilot …` in `packages/cli/lib/dispatch.mjs` runBin, the quota helper and the systemd unit all SPAWN it; `main()` at line 77 runs only when the file is the process entry, line 94), `lib/mutations.mjs` (the seam registry: `FOUNDATION_SEAMS`, `registerSeams`, `knownSeams`, `active`, `enable`, `disable`, `clearAll`, `activeSeams`, `withMutation`), 58 lib modules that call `registerSeams([...])` at import and `active('name')` at the defect site, `lib/cli.mjs` (`dispatch`, called in-process by tests). Nothing outside `packages/autopilot` imports the registry. Tests: `npm test -w packages/autopilot` from the worktree root (about 90 s). `test/spec-coverage.test.mjs` + `test/ac-registry.mjs` are the acceptance-criteria gate: with `AUTOPILOT_GATE_FULL=1` (`npm run test:gate -w packages/autopilot`, node >= 20) they import every registered test file into ONE process and run each registered function under `withMutation(<seam>)`; 22 other test files call `withMutation` directly; `test/status.test.mjs:102-152` re-enables the parent's `activeSeams()` inside bare `node --input-type=module -e` children via `enable()`; `test/cli.test.mjs:13` imports the bin module in-process. The seams are REQUIRED by the approved spec `docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md` (§16 criteria 1, 114, 121) and `spec-coverage.test.mjs:184` pins that file's sha256 to a signed approval record: do not edit the spec, the registry or the gate. This change keeps every seam and every existing test working; it only removes the ability to activate a seam in a process started through the bin.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `lib/mutations.mjs` holds its state in module-private bindings (`const known = new Set()`, `const activeSet = new Set()`, `let sealed = false`). The identifier `globalThis` must not appear in the file (comments included). Every existing export keeps its name, signature and current unsealed behaviour (including `registerSeams` name validation, `active`/`enable` throwing `unknown mutation seam: <name>`, and `withMutation` restoring the prior state). Leave unchanged lines byte-identical (the name regex, the `FOUNDATION_SEAMS` table).
2. Two new exports: `sealSeams()` sets `sealed = true` and clears `activeSet`; it is irreversible (no unseal export). `seamsSealed()` returns the boolean. Once sealed: `active(name)` returns `false` for every known name and still throws for an unknown one; `enable(name)` checks the name FIRST (unknown name: `unknown mutation seam: <name>`, in every state) and THEN throws `Error('mutation seams are sealed in this process')`, so `withMutation` rejects with that error WITHOUT calling `fn`; `disable`, `clearAll`, `activeSeams`, `knownSeams` never throw and `activeSeams()` is `[]`. Suggested shape, which keeps every changed line observable by a test: `active()` returns `!sealed && activeSet.has(name)`.
3. There must be NO environment variable, CLI flag, config key, file or package.json import condition that enables a seam or unseals the registry.
4. `bin/adlc-autopilot.mjs` imports `sealSeams` from `../lib/mutations.mjs` and calls it as the FIRST statement inside `main()` (before the `--help` early exit). It must not be called at module top level (importing the bin must not seal: `cli.test.mjs` and the single-process gate import it) and must not be called from `lib/cli.mjs`, `lib/context.mjs` or any other lib module (tests and the gate call those in-process). Do not write the text `sealSeams()` in a comment in the bin.
5. Replace the header comment of `lib/mutations.mjs` (the paragraph saying seams live on the process global) with at most 12 lines stating: seams are test-only fault injection; state is module-private; the bin entry seals the registry before dispatch; a sealed process cannot activate a seam. Describe the code only: no history of how the change came about.
6. Regression guard: `npm test -w packages/autopilot` and `npm run test:gate -w packages/autopilot` stay green with NO edit to any existing test, helper, registry or spec file.
7. Documentation: in `packages/autopilot/README.md`, section `## The AC coverage gate`, add one paragraph: the seams are test-only; `lib/mutations.mjs` keeps them module-private; `bin/adlc-autopilot.mjs` calls `sealSeams()` before dispatch, so a process started through the CLI cannot activate a seam. State the limits plainly: only processes started through the bin are sealed (a process that imports `lib/` directly, such as the test suite, is not); sealing does not defend against code that runs before `main()` (a `--require`/`--import` preload or a loader hook), which already controls the process. `docs/tools/autopilot.md` does not exist and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/autopilot.mdx` does not describe tests or seams, so there is no mirror to edit.

NEW FILES. `packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs`: uses `node:test` directly (not `./helpers/node-test.mjs`); do NOT add it to `test/ac-registry.mjs`; title the tests descriptively, NOT with an `AC<n>:` prefix (in this package that prefix denotes a spec §16 criterion); mints no temp directories; contains no test-skipping or test-focusing calls; every `spawnSync` carries a `timeout` and passes NO `env` option (never `env: { ...process.env }`: a repository guard rejects an inherited-spread env on a spawn that names `bin/adlc-*.mjs`). `packages/autopilot/test/helpers/seal-probe.mjs`: imports `enable, active, activeSeams, seamsSealed` from `../../lib/mutations.mjs`; calls `enable('keys.leakKey')`; registers `process.on('exit')` that tries `enable('keys.leakKey')` again and writes ONE line `seal-probe ` + JSON `{sealed, active, activeSeams, enableRefused}` to fd 2 with `writeSync`; sets `process.argv[1]` to the absolute path of `../../bin/adlc-autopilot.mjs`; then `await import()`s that path (as a file URL) so `main()` runs. Sealed-state assertions run in spawned child processes (`process.execPath`), never in the test process itself.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 After importing `../lib/mutations.mjs` and `../lib/keys.mjs`, `Object.hasOwn(globalThis, '__adlcAutopilotMutations')` is false; after assigning a forged `{ active: new Set(['keys.leakKey']), known: new Set(['keys.leakKey']) }` to that global (removed in `finally`), `active('keys.leakKey')` is false and `childEnv({ PATH: '/usr/bin' }, { key: 'k'.repeat(32) })` has no `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY`. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs`
- AC2 A child that runs `Object.defineProperty(Object.prototype, '__adlcAutopilotMutations', { value: { active: [], known: [] }, configurable: true })` and then imports `lib/mutations.mjs` and `lib/keys.mjs` exits 0 and reports `active('keys.leakKey') === false`. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs`
- AC3 In a child: `enable('keys.leakKey')`, then `sealSeams()` → `seamsSealed()` true, `active('keys.leakKey')` false, `activeSeams()` deep-equals `[]`, `enable('keys.leakKey')` throws /sealed/, `enable('no.such')` throws /unknown mutation seam/, `withMutation('keys.leakKey', fn)` rejects /sealed/ and `fn` was never called, `active('no.such')` throws /unknown mutation seam/, `disable`/`clearAll` do not throw. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs`
- AC4 Unsealed semantics, in-process: `seamsSealed()` is false; inside `withMutation(x, fn)` `active(x)` is true and after it false; a seam enabled before `withMutation` is still enabled after it (then disabled by the test in `finally`); `enable('no.such')` throws /unknown mutation seam/. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs`
- AC5 The bin seals before anything else: `node packages/autopilot/test/helpers/seal-probe.mjs --help` exits 0, stdout contains `adlc-autopilot`, and the stderr line beginning `seal-probe ` parses to exactly `{"sealed":true,"active":false,"activeSeams":[],"enableRefused":true}`. This is the ONLY proof of the call in the bin (its two changed lines yield no mutants), so confirm once that it goes red with the call removed and with the call moved below the `--help` exit, and say so in the PR body. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs`
- AC6 Importing the bin does not seal: after `await import('../bin/adlc-autopilot.mjs')` in the test process `seamsSealed()` is false. verify: `node --test packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs`
- AC7 No global and no switch in shipped code. verify: `grep -c globalThis packages/autopilot/lib/mutations.mjs` prints `0`; `grep -rn __adlcAutopilotMutations packages/autopilot/lib packages/autopilot/bin` prints nothing (exit 1); `grep -c 'sealSeams()' packages/autopilot/bin/adlc-autopilot.mjs` prints `1`
- AC8 Existing package suite green with no existing test edited. verify: `npm test -w packages/autopilot` exits 0 and `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- packages/autopilot/test` lists only `packages/autopilot/test/seam-containment.test.mjs` and `packages/autopilot/test/helpers/seal-probe.mjs`
- AC9 The full acceptance-criteria gate still proves every fixture bites. verify (node >= 20): `npm run test:gate -w packages/autopilot` exits 0
- AC10 README updated. verify: `grep -c sealSeams packages/autopilot/README.md` prints >= 1
- AC11 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (each draw re-runs the package suite, about 90 s; expect roughly 15-20 minutes). Expected and fine: a warning that `packages/autopilot/bin/adlc-autopilot.mjs` had budget but no mutable lines. Do NOT run `--max 80` for this package: that many draws cannot fit the gate's 45-minute window at this suite cost and the script exits 1 before mutating anything.

OUT OF SCOPE: deleting any seam, `registerSeams` block or `active()` call site; editing `docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md`, `test/spec-coverage.test.mjs`, `test/ac-registry.mjs` or any existing test; adding an `exports` map or import conditions to `packages/autopilot/package.json`; the second test-only global `__adlcAutopilotGateExec` in `test/helpers/node-test.mjs`; the README's "~25 minutes" timing note; comment clean-up elsewhere in the package.
title: autopilot: make mutation seams unactivatable in a production process (module-private registry, sealed by the bin entry)
